# Course Model v11 originals — TEST ONLY

The Build 255 (v11) versions of the Exercise Laboratory, the Edge Case
Course and the `demo_courses` Pick the translation demo (the Piedmontese
demo's left with its Course in Build 262 Revision 0), kept for the Build
256 tests that check the v11 → v12 conversion (`course_model_v11_243_test.dart`,
`course_model_v12_256_test.dart`): the Dart converter and its Python
mirror (`tools/qql_course_v12.py`) must produce the current
`assets/courses` files from these, and the app must refuse them. Nothing
in the app reads this folder.
